findings.current: Death Knights raced through the air on ghostly horses, each commanding a legion as they filled the vast ruins.
findings.defect: The English makes it sound as though the Death Knights themselves fill the ruins; the Korean has them lead their legions to do so.
findings.rationale: 각자의 군단을 통솔하여 makes their command of the legions part of how the ruins are filled.
findings.replacement: Death Knights raced through the air on ghostly horses and led their legions to fill the vast ruins.
findings.source: 유령마를 타고 허공을 질주한 데스나이트(Death Knight)들은 각자의 군단을 통솔하여 드넓은 폐허를 메웠다.

findings.current: —The lives of two humans—nothing compared to the lives of billions of your human kind.
findings.defect: Morgoth demands two humans, not their lives. The draft makes the tribute sound like their deaths.
findings.rationale: 고작 두 명의 인간을 names the people as the demanded tribute; 목숨 applies to the billions used for comparison.
findings.replacement: —Just two humans—a paltry price next to the lives of billions of your kind.
findings.source: 수십억 인간족의 목숨과는 비교할 수도 없는, 고작 두 명의 인간을.

findings.defect: The draft corrects the deliberate typo in the angry reply, removing the basis for the next commenter’s observation.
findings.rationale: The broken spelling of 시ㅂㅏㄹ is why the following comment says the Korean is so worked up he made a typo.

findings.current: At last, people saw footage of the monster army taking control of all of Russia and advancing in every direction. They had no choice but to fall silent.
findings.defect: The draft presents the takeover of Russia as still underway; the army has already seized the entire country and is advancing beyond it.
findings.rationale: 장악하고 establishes control of Russia before the ongoing advance described by 진격하는.
findings.replacement: At last, people saw footage of the monster army that had seized all of Russia and was advancing in every direction. They had no choice but to fall silent.
findings.source: 마침내 러시아 전역을 장악하고, 사방으로 진격하는 몬스터 군단의 모습을 영상으로 확인한 사람들은 모두 침묵을 택할 수밖에 없었다.

summary: The draft changes Morgoth’s demanded tribute into two deaths, obscures who fills the ruins, loses a typo that drives a joke, and shifts Russia’s conquest from completed to ongoing.
